image_description: A black and white photograph showing the interior of a dark, arched stone or brick tunnel leading to a bright, barred gate. The walls are textured and rough, suggesting age and confinement. The gate at the end is tall with vertical bars and an arched top, letting in strong light which creates a high-contrast silhouette effect.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a tight interior shot of a corridor/tunnel; the exterior scale and grounds are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: High perimeter walls with minimal decorative elements.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Perimeter walls are exterior features; this image shows interior tunnel walls.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: These specific building types and yards are not visible in this single corridor view.

The stark, dark, arched tunnel with heavy iron bars conveys a utilitarian and imposing atmosphere typical of correctional facilities.
No chain-link or palisade fencing is visible; only solid walls and a barred gate.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the scene is classified as a prison/correctional facility rather than a generic dungeon or cellar.
To verify the linear perspective of the tunnel and the structural integrity of the arch and gate.
To ensure the bars of the gate are distinct, continuous, and correctly connected to the frame without melting or fusion artifacts.
To check for noise, texture anomalies in the shadows, or AI-generated blurring in the high-contrast areas.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the barred gate (continuity of bars)
Perspective consistency of the tunnel walls
Texture realism of the stone/brick walls
Lighting consistency between the dark interior and bright exterior
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection of the gate bars and the frame. AI often fails to render thin, parallel structures like bars correctly, causing them to merge or waver. Also, check if the 'light' coming through the gate looks physically plausible or if it has a glowing/halo artifact common in AI generations.
